table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END,   
         aliasname=item.customicode, 
		localitemname=max(item.localitemname),
		class=(select name from itemclass where itemclass.iccode=max(item.iccode)),   
		itemcategory=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=max(item.icatcode)),
		manf=(select name from manufacturer where manufacturer.manfcode=max(item.manfcode)),
		color=(select name from itemcolour where itemcolour.icolourcode=max(item.icolourcode)),
		size=(select name from itemsize where itemsize.isizecode=max(item.isizecode)),
		Packing=(select name from itempacking where itempacking.packcode=max(item.packcode)),
		manfalisa=(select aliasname from manufacturer where manufacturer.manfcode=max(item.manfcode)),
		agency=(select name from goodscompany GS where GS.gccode=max(saleledger.gccode)),
         packingdesc=max(item.packingdesc), 
		purunitrate=max(saledetail.purunitrate),
		purvalue=max(saledetail.purunitrate)*(sum(saledetail.looseqty)+sum(saledetail.bonusqty)),
			amt=max(saleledger.amt),  
         accname =max( dbo.accounts.name),   
         address =max( dbo.customer.address1),   
         address2=max( dbo.customer.address2),
		custcity=max(dbo.customer.city),   
		custphone=max(dbo.customer.phone),
         salesman = dbo.users.username,   
         saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,   
         date = dbo.saleledger.date,
         invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
			salecatcode =max( dbo.saleledger.salecatcode),
         gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
         icode = saledetail.icode,   
         batch = max(saledetail.batch),   
         expiry =min( saledetail.expiry),   
         looseqty =sum( saledetail.looseqty),   
         bonusqty =sum( saledetail.bonusqty),   
         packqty = sum(saledetail.packqty),   
         packunits=max( saledetail.packunits),   
         saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
         discperc = saledetail.discperc,  
			itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
         salestax =max( saledetail.salestax),   
         Id =max( dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),   
         posted=max(saleledger.posted),   
        /* balance=ISNULL(saleledger.balance, 0),   */
		balance=(select isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0) from virtualgl v
						where v.acccode=max(accounts.acccode) group by v.acccode),  
         unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
         gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
         invgstperc =max( saleledger.invgstperc1),   
         custTaxRegno=max(customer.salestaxregno)  ,
		custrefno=max(	dbo.saleledger.custrefno),	
		custref2=max(saleledger.custrefno2),
		custrefno3=max(saleledger.custrefno3),
			dbo.saleledger.remarks,
			printwaranty=max(dbo.saleledger.printwaranty),
			printbatch=max(dbo.saleledger.printbatch),
			custcode=saleledger.custcode,
			printbalance=max(saleledger.printbalance),
			messages=(select description from message where messagecode=max(saleledger.messagecode))

    FROM saleledger,   
         saledetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  

   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode >= :ar_SInvCode ) AND  
		( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode <= :ar_lInvCode ) AND  
		( dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:ai_CustCode) ) AND 
         ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    

GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode, 
			saleledger.date, 
			saleledger.custcode, 
			saleledger.discperc, 
			saleledger.flatdisc, 
			saleledger.misccharges, 
			saleledger.headerno,
			saleledger.salestax, 
			saleledger.remarks, 
			saledetail.icode, 
/*			saledetail.rowgroup,*/
			saledetail.saleprice,
			saledetail.itemflatdisc,
			saledetail.discperc,
			saledetail.gstperc,
			saledetail.unitsalestax,
			saledetail.gcode, 
			item.name,
			item.icode,
			item.printable,
			item.customicode,
			users.username

ORDER BY /*dbo.item.customicode,*/
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
			itemcategory,
			item.name

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 1 )

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)
